formulas.annualized_revenue: (raw_segment_revenue - internal - noncompute - pass_through - separately_identified_financing_accretion)*4; all deductions need sources
formulas.average_effective_IT_MW: sum(cohort_active_IT_MW*physical_utilization*active_days_Q2)/91; do not apply utilization to already measured utilized load
formulas.utilization_sensitivity: At fixed R and usable IT capacity C: R/(C*u); moving u1 to u2 scales metric u1/u2, not profitability.
formulas.PUE_sensitivity: At fixed facility power F: R*PUE/(F*u); a higher PUE mechanically raises this ratio by reducing IT denominator, not efficiency.
formulas.power_cost: IT_energy_MWh*PUE*all_in_power_price_USD_per_MWh; tariff and generation boundaries must match
formulas.Jevons: volume_growth_break_even=d/(1-d), 0<=d<1; no matched realized price decline available

structured_deals.economic_effect: Original nine tranches: $17.3929B stated fees and approximately $6.9581B scheduled upfront payments, not all cash collected. January addendum adds two tranches with no upfront payment. Monthly fee uses GPUs times rate times hours; counts/rates/schedules redacted. Acceptance, availability and termination credits matter despite fees independent of usage. August 12 all-tranche delivery claim, including two in prior month, cannot establish Q2 capacity.

Five-year $12B dedicated capacity plus up to $15B specified available/unsold capacity. Never double-count third-party sales and Meta purchases of same capacity. November 2025 $2.8807B agreement separate. Section 15 bankruptcy-remote SPV prerequisite is not proof of closed financing; affiliate obligations and force-majeure clauses prevent blanket guarantee inference. ASC606 service revenue, not customer equipment-lease revenue.

Four large deals at $20–25M annual contract value per stated MW, primarily 2027 revenue on capacity arriving late 2026. 70% of deals include prepayments covering 50–60% associated capex. Claimed 22-month payback includes forecast capex/related opex and revenue recognition excluding prepayment; not independently reproduced financed/replacement cash payback. $40–50M short-term pricing opportunity/first deal in early Q3 concerns 3–6-month terms, not durable fleet pricing.

Bloom installs, operates and maintains; Nebius purchases capacity and electricity. Approximately 328MW installed and 250MW guaranteed generation; three phases each ten years; up to $2.6B aggregate service fees subject to conditions. 328/250=1.312 is NOT PUE. Ceiling allocation $1.04M per guaranteed generation MW-year is not all-in power tariff or Nebius revenue. Fuel/pass-through terms and actual commissioning undisclosed.

$2.1751B commenced undiscounted operating-lease payments versus $1.6253B liability; $12.0541B uncommenced payments and $612.4M associated prepayments. Future starts 2026–27, terms up to 12 years. Do not sum liability and cash payment schedule or call all equipment GPU leases. Other fixed/minimum commitments primarily energy/power total $5.3241B; Bloom overlap not reconciled so do not add its $2.6B again.

$775M at one-month SOFR floor zero plus 2.50%, due October 31 2030; 1.15 DSCR and minimum liquidity. Borrower assets and shares pledged. Parent nonrecourse bad-acts guarantee plus manager/colocator performance guarantees are not an unlimited parent debt guarantee. Historical annual no-material-offbalance disclosure cannot establish later SPV/VIE treatment; private full facility agreement unavailable.

Actual $5.75B gross issuance, not $5B base pricing: $3.45B at 0.5% due February 15 2030 and $2.30B at 4.5% due February 15 2034. Principal accretes to 110% and 125%; $6.67B at respective maturities if outstanding, $0.92B additional principal. Annual stated coupons on original principal total $120.75M, excluding fees/special interest. Conversion/redemption changes cash settlement. $800M old-note exchange agreements for approximately 15.8M shares are separate; completion not independently verified.

NVIDIA $2B pre-funded warrants are equity financing, not customer revenue. Announced partners own hardware, land, facility and power while Nebius supplies software/architecture/GTM. Gross/net accounting, customer-owned GPU attribution, replacement and minimum-spend obligations need disclosure before importing partner MW.
Preferred infrastructure and intended compute/inference integration. No disclosed committed MW, price, minimum spend or binding delivery schedule; no booked revenue/capacity inferred.
